evals.prompt: Update the implementation notes for PR #123 so it tells the fulfillment story of the original issue intent.
evals.expected_output: Agent gates to GitHub-only, resolves repo + PR #123, resolves linked issue(s), extracts intent from the issue body using intent-section heuristics, fetches PR evidence (title/body + changed files), then inserts/replaces only the marker-bounded `Implementation notes` region in the PR body with Original intent / Implemented / Deviations/tradeoffs. Confirms what changed and what evidence was used.

evals.prompt: Refresh PR #77 implementation notes after additional commits (intent should remain consistent).
evals.expected_output: Agent updates only the owned marker section for PR #77, preserves other PR content outside markers, and avoids inventing deviations; it ties implementation bullets to changed file paths from the PR evidence.

evals.prompt: Add Jira ticket acceptance notes into a Bitbucket PR description.
evals.expected_output: Agent does not operate outside GitHub context; it treats it as a near-miss and asks for the GitHub PR/URL to update, without editing Jira/Bitbucket.
